verdict.rationale: Cline is an AI coding assistant that runs inside editors, so inline completions and next-edit suggestions are a fair question for it. However, the evidence describes only agentic, approval-gated editing (diffs, Plan/Act, terminal commands) and never mentions as-you-type inline completions or next-edit suggestions. The Kanban 'inline comments' feature is for reviewing diffs, not code completion, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
